contexts.text: See Charity.
That they can grow there.
The child grew = the further perfection of the Lord's Rational. To grow = to be perfected.
Winter, when nothing grows.
The man grew, and he went in going and increasing () = increasings... of good and truth in their order...
Unless the Spiritual from the Lord continually acted within into their primitive forms... they would never vegetate and grow...
Then the seeds (of truth) grow.
To grow as to the will of good. Signified.
To grow as to the understanding of truth. Signified.
To grow to a multitude in the midst of the land () = extension from the inmost... Growth into a multitude = extension.
That the truths of the Church grew as to good. Signified, Explained.
That they grew most as to truths from good. Signified, Explained.
Through truths, good grows... Then man is in good and from good in truths, which then grow continually; but little while he lives in the world... Thus, wisdom can grow to eternity...
That truths grew according to the infestations. Signified, Explained.
The child grew = increase from good. Explained. AC 6755.
These two loves grow in proportion as...
The spiritual life grows through temptations...
Lest men should increase beyond what the Earth could support.
All goods increase immensely there.
All perfection increases towards the interiors, and decreases towards the exteriors.
That all perfections increase... with degrees...
Seeds... thus germinate and grow.
With these... the faculty of wisdom increases; but with these... it decreases.
The infants... thus grow in stature.
As this New Heaven increases...
The infants... grow according to the state of reception.
To go out and grow as fatted calves () = the increasing of all good.
This is signified by the horn and its growth.
Let them grow together until the harvest. AE 911:7. Explained.
Grow as a cedar in Lebanon. AE 518:15.
Grow to the ends of the earth. Explained.
The seed germinates and grows he knoweth not how. Explained.
